title: Say what you do not do
communication_goal: El estudiante puede expresar hábitos que no realiza usando don't y doesn't.
situation: Comparar hábitos y explicar diferencias de rutina.
language_focus: I do not usually watch TV.

vocabulary.example: I don't watch TV at night.

context.before: Two friends compare what they do and do not do during the week.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.text: No, I don't. I don't work on Sundays.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.text: No, he doesn't. He drinks tea.

explanation_es: Para negar hábitos usamos don't con I, you, we y they; usamos doesn't con he, she e it. Después de don't/doesn't el verbo vuelve a la forma base: She doesn't drink, no She doesn't drinks.
spanish_speaker_notes: No añadas la s después de doesn't.
Don't y doesn't llevan la negación; el verbo principal no lleva terminación de tercera persona.
Aprende la respuesta completa No, I don't / No, he doesn't para conversar.

pronunciation.target: Distinguir don't y doesn't en respuestas negativas.
pronunciation.student_feedback: Haz audible la negación y mantén el verbo principal en forma base.

reading.title: Different habits
reading.text: Maya works on Saturdays, but she doesn't work on Sundays. Luis doesn't drink coffee. He drinks tea. They don't eat dinner late because they get up early.

activities.instruction: Clasifica la negación según el sujeto.
Escucha y elige el hábito que no realiza.
activities.feedback_correct: Entendiste la negación y la acción.
Después de doesn't usamos drink sin s.
Doesn't ya marca la tercera persona.

activities.prompt: I don't work on Sundays. She doesn't drink coffee.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Enfatiza don't/doesn't y mantén work/drink sin s.

activities.instruction: Lee las rutinas y completa una tabla de sí/no.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Busca doesn't work, doesn't drink y don't eat.

activities.instruction: La IA es tu compañero. Comparen tres hábitos y expliquen una diferencia negativa.
activities.student_goal: Use don't and doesn't to compare habits.

activities.instruction: Graba tres frases: dos hábitos que no haces y uno que otra persona no hace.
activities.prompt: I don't ____. I don't ____. He/She doesn't ____.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Usa don't con I y doesn't con he/she; no añadas s al verbo.
Don't con I; doesn't con she; después de doesn't va el verbo base.

mastery_criteria.retry_policy: Los errores se programan para recuperación a 1, 3, 7 y 14 días.
